item.title: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
item.description: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Huang's return as a national security risk.
item.dc:creator: Shannon Bond

item.title: Google employees protest AI in schools policy
item.description: More than 550 Google employees signed a petition to allow schools access to Search without AI. Parents and educators protested outside Google offices in 6 cities last week for the same ask.
item.dc:creator: Sequoia Carrillo

item.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
item.description: U.N. talks in Geneva have failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons, as humanitarian groups warn that military AI is advancing far faster than diplomacy.
item.dc:creator: Imogen Foulkes

item.title: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?
item.description: Critics say now that the AI giant is a public company, its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will be tested.
item.dc:creator: Katie McQue

item.title: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms
item.description: AI stocks — and the broader markets — got pummeled this week, raising major concerns about the financial system and the wider economy. Here's what to know.
item.dc:creator: Rafael Nam
